segments.en: To the honor of the delight of my eyes — my very self and my flesh — Mr. Shne'ur Zalman Shazar, who draws himself to the Tzadik — who is the heart of the world — and who has sharpened his ears to hear the most awesome and wondrous song and melody from all the ten kinds of melody of the true Tzadik. Through which he burns and blazes and consumes the root of the filth of the falsehood of heresy and false faiths. And through this heals the King's Daughter — who is the collective of the souls of Israel. The King Moshiach will play this melody in the future — and through it he will reveal to all eyes His G-dliness and His kingship and His dominion. And he will repair the entire world and bring all of them close to Hashem Yisburach and His Torah. Through which His G-dliness will be revealed in the world — and this is the essential revelation of the truth — to open their eyes to see the light of the new lights, who will reveal awesome and wondrous novelties beyond all reckoning [alternate version: without limit] — who has revealed new awesome and wondrous lights beyond all reckoning.
